build_detector: build a 3D detector model from a config object with optional train and test configurations
build_backbone: build a backbone network from a config object using the BACKBONES registry
build_head: build a detection head from a config object using the HEADS registry
build_voxel_encoder: build a voxel encoder from a config object using the VOXEL_ENCODERS registry
build_fusion_layer: build a fusion layer from a config object using the FUSION_LAYERS registry
